description: Remove a clip and close the gap it leaves, shifting later clips earlier on the clip's own track and on every sync-locked track so audio stays in sync. With the default scope the clip's linked audio/video partners are removed with it and their tracks close up too, even when not sync-locked; with scope 'own_track' the partners stay in place (reported as linkedPartnersKept). Premiere's QE rippleDelete() and the DOM's rippleEdit flag are both non-functional on 26.x, so this is done explicitly and verified. Refuses without changing anything if a clip on a participating track straddles the ripple point or sits inside the range being closed.

allow_large_ripple.description: Allow a ripple above large_ripple_threshold after its preflight estimate.

dry_run.description: Validate and report the shift plan without changing the timeline (default: false)

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

large_ripple_threshold.description: Mover count above which ripple_delete refuses unless allow_large_ripple is true (default: 400).

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to ripple delete

range_content.description: What to do about other clips on participating tracks that sit entirely inside the time range being closed (the usual case in a multicam-style sequence with aligned clips). With scope 'sync_locked' the clip's own linked audio/video partners are always removed with it, as in Premiere; with 'own_track' they are kept. 'refuse' (default) changes nothing and reports them; 'delete' also removes them, i.e. lifts that whole time segment out of every participating track and closes up. 'delete' is destructive across tracks -- the removed clips are listed in the result.

scope.description: Which tracks shift: 'sync_locked' (default) shifts the clip's track plus every sync-locked track, matching Premiere's ripple behaviour; 'own_track' shifts only the clip's own track and WILL desync other tracks.

name: ripple_delete

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
